inputs.text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
